lede: Every invideo AI plan, how many credits each seat gets, and the cheapest plan for the AI video and images you make each month.
calc_label: InVideo credits you need each month
calc_note: Prices and credits are per seat. The calculator uses the plans on invideo's pricing page, with Max at 5,000, 8,000 or 10,000 credits a month. invideo puts a Seedance 2.0 Fast video at about 30 credits and a Nano Banana Pro image at about 2.5. Unused credits do not roll over to the next month.

after_plans: All prices are per seat. Plus also comes with 5,000 credits at $150/month, the same price as Max with 5,000. Max on the card is for 8,000 credits a month; other credit options change the price, as in the table. Regular yearly billing costs the same as 12 monthly payments, except Starter at $10/month. Black Friday offers on invideo's page, billed yearly: Plus at $24/month with 2,000 credits ($288 a year) and Max at $60/month with 5,000 credits ($720 a year); the sale countdown ends on 27 November 2026. On monthly billing the first month of Max is $135, $220 or $265, then the regular price. invideo has no free plan on its pricing page. Team, Business and Enterprise plans are listed separately.

compare.What you pay for: Credits per seat: about 30 for a Seedance 2.0 Fast video, 2.5 for a Nano Banana Pro image
compare.Cheapest paid plan: Starter: $20/month, or $10/month billed yearly, for 400 credits
compare.Yearly billing: 50% off on Starter; other plans cost the same as monthly, apart from limited offers

faq: Per seat: Starter is $20/month or $10/month billed yearly for 400 credits, Plus is $60/month for 2,000 credits, and Max is $250/month for 8,000 credits, from $150/month (5,000) to $300/month (10,000). invideo also runs limited yearly offers on Plus and Max.

Credits are used for video creation, generative models and other features, not for downloading content. Each model costs a different number of credits: about 30 for a Seedance 2.0 Fast video and about 2.5 for a Nano Banana Pro image.
Do unused InVideo credits roll over?
No. Unused credits don't roll over to the next month.
invideo's pricing page lists no free plan. The cheapest plan is Starter at $20 per seat a month, or $10 billed yearly.
